Team,

Quick reconciliation for BrightPath (BP-2026-Q4-71). Forecast shows a $420k ARR commit for 12/15 renewal, but SFDC latest stage is marked as Commit with 90% probability and we have conflicting notes from CS indicating a potential concession ask. I attached a one-pager with the numbers (brightpath_renewal_summary.pdf).

Asks (short):
- Please confirm the final ARR number we should carry for finance (best case / commit) by EOD Monday.
- If you recommend a stage change, state new stage + reason (e.g., concession requested, exec sponsor at risk).
- If you want finance to bake in a partial holdback, propose the % reduction.

Key facts:
- Current contract ARR: $400k (12 month renewal)
- Sales-opps expected ARR: +20k upsell = $420k total
- CS notes an ask for 20% discount and a delayed PO until Jan. Sam Ortiz (BrightPath) has been slow on paperwork.

Attached: brightpath_renewal_summary.pdf (breakdown), please also review the churn indicators sheet I asked CS to populate.

I'll consolidate responses and update the forecast. If we downgrade the commit, we need to notify FP&A before the close of day.

Thanks,

Tessa / Marissa —

Agree with moving to Best Case. A couple of risk signals from our monitoring that pushed me to that conclusion (see attached BrightPath_churn_signals.xlsx):
- Exec sponsor hasn't engaged in 45 days (no C-level logins to admin console).
- Delayed PO + finance team requesting a usage report to justify spend.
- Reported performance issue on a 2-week window that was escalated to infra; CS marker shows unresolved items.

Proposed actions (short):
- Move to Best Case for forecast: $336k (carry 80% of expected).
- Schedule a joint exec call this week with Sam Ortiz + Laura to re-surface value and discuss PO timeline — I can join to review performance remediation steps.
- Offer a short-term credit (no more than 5%) tied to performance SLA remediation; legal must pre-approve.

If we do not get a PO by 12/10, downgrade to Commit-At-Risk and alert FP&A for month-end adjustments.

Vivek
